newsitem.title: USA: Beacon Properties buys Chicago-area complex.
newsitem.headline: Beacon Properties buys Chicago-area complex.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp said Tuesday it has bought a five-building office complex in the suburban Chicago community of Westchester for $182.1 million.
The company said it paid for the 1.1 million-square-foot Westbrook Corporate Center with $26.1 million in cash, $50 million in operating partnership units and a $106 million mortgage.
The net operating income from the Westbrook complex is estimated at $18.3 million based on annualized rental income, the company said. The complex has an occupancy rate of 92 percent, it said.
Beacon said it owns or has an operating interest in 115 properties in its target markets of Boston, Atlanta, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Washington, D.C.
